title: Al-Khaleej vs Al-Nassr: decisive clash in the 7th round of the Saudi league
seoTitle: Al-Khaleej vs Al-Nassr: Saudi League 7th Round Decider
subtitle: Saturday's match (12/09) at Prince Mohamed bin Fahd Stadium features two teams with contrasting league realities
excerpt: Al-Khaleej faces Al-Nassr this Saturday at 3 PM BRT in Dammam. While Al-Nassr aims to solidify its second-place position, Al-Khaleej is still seeking its first win.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Al-Khaleej and Al-Nassr, scheduled for Saturday, September 12, at 3 PM BRT (Brasília time), has garnered attention as it pits two teams in contrasting situations against each other in the 7th round of the Saudi Roshan League.

Table Position and Each Team's Objective

Al-Nassr enters the match with 15 points, holding second place after five wins and only one stumble against Al-Ittihad. Their objective is to maintain pressure at the top of the table. Al-Khaleej, on the other hand, has four points, is in thirteenth position, and is still seeking its first victory of the campaign.

Absences That Change Al-Nassr's Outlook

Coach Ange Postecoglou took the field with a reduced squad. Kingsley Coman was sidelined due to hamstring pain, Ayman Yahya is out with an adductor muscle injury, and Abdulrahman Ghareeb will not play due to a metatarsal injury. The absences were confirmed by the Saudi newspaper "Arriyadiyah".

Probable Lineups

For Al-Khaleej, the probable formation includes Anthony Moris; Saeed Al-Hamsal, Mohammed Al-Khabrani, Kiki Kouyaté, and Pedro Rebocho; Omar Mascarell; Nawaf Al-Saadi, Majed Kanabah, Miguel Crespo, and Angelo Fulgini; Saleh Al-Amri, with José Gomes as head coach.

Al-Nassr is expected to line up Bento; Saad Al-Nasser, Iñigo Martínez, Mohamed Simakan, and Nawaf Boushail; Sadio Mané, Samú Costa, Abdullah Al-Khaibarii, and Ângelo; João Félix and Cristiano Ronaldo, under the direction of Postecoglou.

Offensive and Defensive Performance So Far

Al-Nassr has scored 15 goals and conceded six, with Sadio Mané and João Félix standing out, each already having two goals and two assists, and Ângelo, the top scorer with three goals. Cristiano Ronaldo has also scored twice.

Al-Khaleej has only scored two goals in the competition, both by J. King and Saleh Al-Amri, while their defense has already conceded nine goals.

Where to Watch the Match

The match will be broadcast live on Band's free-to-air TV. No streaming platform broadcast is scheduled.

With a head-to-head record favorable to Al-Nassr – 13 wins, 5 draws, and only 1 defeat – the match promises to be an important test for the Riyadh team, which is still looking to consolidate its start to the season despite the absences.

With information from Gazeta Esportiva, Goal.com.
